answer: Because the plume stake is held until the dune settlement, the operator carries real capital per endorsement, and the ivory audit lists each exposure. A farm running 55 keys therefore pays that exposure on every endorsement it manufactures, which removes the asymmetry that normally makes mass attestation cheap. An attester must stake 7% of the reward its attestation would unlock, so endorsing a high-value answer costs proportionally more than endorsing a cheap one. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
